findings.evidence: The migration redefines the whole purge_expired_account_deletion_requests body from the Base (052e53a) SCHEMA.sql. The parallel run r96-web-push, merged into main first (18d5f0c), also redefines that function and adds DELETE FROM public.push_subscriptions. The R102 body does not contain that line, and merging the branch will also conflict in SCHEMA.sql, README, TESTS.sql and database.types.ts.
findings.impact: Applying MIGRATION_R102_EXPENSE_PRESETS.sql after MIGRATION_R96_WEB_PUSH.sql in production replaces the purge function without the push_subscriptions cleanup, so a deleted account's push subscriptions are no longer removed by the purge (they would rely only on the auth.users ON DELETE CASCADE).
findings.recommendation: Iteration-02: merge main into the run branch, resolve the conflicts so SCHEMA.sql keeps both cleanup lines, add DELETE FROM public.push_subscriptions to the R102 migration's purge body, note in README that R102 runs after R96, and re-run the local DB gate.
